scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-dimensional proof; numerical and rational checks are finite; no claim of field validation, new general optimization principles, independent validation or exhaustive literature coverage.
scientific_limitations: Single uniformly selected ignition, homogeneous path and loss, independent edge crossings, dimensionless exponential investment response; first activation threshold all sizes and four-patch continuation only, no general later support law; empirical calibration and historical priority are not established.
title: Parity-dependent activation thresholds for budgeted probabilistic firebreaks on a path
